ValidationRule.description: Ensures that changes to the Document Model are not possible ,If the lead subscription model is "ila" or "alburaq"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.Setting__c.Bypass_Validation_Rules__c), ISCHANGED( Document_Model__c ), OR( TEXT(Lead__r.Subscription_Model__c ) = 'ila', TEXT(Lead__r.Subscription_Model__c ) = 'alburaq' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Document Model on the Content record cannot be changed. Please contact your administrator.
